shared_elements: bearded male figure with elaborate headdress/crown
low relief carving of figures with detailed hair and garments
justification: Both depict bearded male figures in strict profile in low relief, with tall headgear and finely patterned hair/beard, and in B a row of small figures facing a principal figure recalls the same convention seen at large scale in A. The biggest difference is content scope: A is an isolated bust-scale head-and-shoulders fragment with no accompanying elements, whereas B shows a full multi-figure scene beneath a winged emblem and above extensive registers of inscribed text.
